name: const unsafe fn copy_to (self , dest : NonNull < T > , count : usize) where T : Sized ,
rule: dest must be valid for writes of count * size_of::<T>() bytes and must remain valid while self is read for count * size_of::<T>() bytes, including when the source and destination ranges overlap.
api: impl < T : ? Sized > core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > { const unsafe fn copy_to (self , dest : core::ptr::non_null::NonNull < T > , count : usize) where T : Sized , }
